planets.name: K2-122 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-122 with a 2.22-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: K2-122 b crosses its star every 2.22 days and is 1.2 times as wide as Earth, found in 2017.
text.introduction: K2-122 b transits K2-122 every 2.22 days and is 1.2 times as wide as Earth. Orbit and size follow Castro-González et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
